name: Phrases marked
look: One large statement with one to three key phrases: a flat tint of the accent draws behind each phrase from left to right, across its line breaks, as it climbs from 85% to 55% of the screen; scrubbed, it runs back on the way up; the text's colour never changes.
phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop (one background size a phrase); under reduced motion the marks stand drawn.

needs.words: one paragraph of 25 to 60 words (never under 12) with 1 to 3 phrases of 2 to 5 words in <mark>, never a whole sentence; the section sized to it (data-screen="band")
